blocks.rationale: The trigger contract permits disclosure only to directors, officers, and employees, whereas the installed helper retained the prior contract’s broader advisor classes. Reading the representative classes and safeguards from each current source preserves the history parent while making consultants, agents, and professional advisors fall outside the trigger contract’s exception.
